assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md header declares 'Project: TC' and 'Vulnerability issue type ID: 10024', and all three JQL queries use 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024', matching the Security Configuration values rather than ad-hoc hardcoded values.

assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md contains three JQL queries: (1) 'labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)' for untriaged, (2) 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New' for triaged-but-new, (3) 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, ON_QA)' for Ready for QA candidates. All three match the required patterns.

assertion_results.text: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md has three clearly separated sections with headings and horizontal rules: '## 1. Untriaged Issues', '## 2. Triaged but still New', '## 3. Ready for QA'.

assertion_results.text: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
assertion_results.evidence: Most issues show all five fields, but the 'Excluded from Ready for QA' table (lines 73-74 in discovery-listing.md) lists TC-9023 and TC-9026 with columns Issue, Status, CVE, Reason — omitting both the full summary and created date. Additionally, the untriaged issues tables (sections 1) lack a per-row Status column, conveying status only via section headers.

assertion_results.text: Status-aware handling: New issues (TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004) are presented for full triage, while the In Progress issue (TC-9003) triggers a warning about active work
assertion_results.evidence: status-handling.md shows TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004 all have 'Handling: Proceed with full triage (default path).' TC-9003 has 'Handling: Warn before proceeding.' with explicit warning text: 'This issue is already in In Progress. It may be actively worked on.'

assertion_results.text: Ready for QA filtering: TC-9020 appears in Ready for QA (all linked Tasks Done/Closed), TC-9023 is excluded (TC-9025 still In Progress), TC-9026 is excluded (no Depend links)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md 'Qualified for QA transition' lists TC-9020 with 'TC-9021 (Done), TC-9022 (Closed)'. 'Excluded from Ready for QA' lists TC-9023 with reason 'Remediation in progress -- TC-9025 still In Progress' and TC-9026 with reason 'No linked remediation Tasks (no Depend links)'.
